appliesTo: every endpoint in scope that reads or changes a resource owned by a user, project, team or role
setup: Two users of the same role (A and B) and, if the app has roles, one user of each role. A creates resources; B and lower roles try to use them.

checks.name: B reads A's resource by id (each GET with an id)
B changes or deletes A's resource (each PATCH/PUT/DELETE)
checks.expect: 403 or 404, record unchanged in the DB

checks.name: B lists a collection
checks.expect: only B's own or shared resources

checks.name: lower role calls each higher-role-only endpoint
B creates a child resource inside A's parent (e.g. a task in A's project)
the same checks through the UI: B opens A's resource URL directly
checks.expect: access denied page or redirect, no data shown

pass: Every check matches, and the read-only DB check shows A's records untouched.
fail: Any of A's data visible to B, any change to A's records, or a lower role succeeding.
fix: Check ownership/membership on the server for every resource id, in one shared guard per resource type; never rely on the UI hiding buttons.
